thread:
ashok: Heads up — customer (acme-inc) says console audit CSV and NDJSON export disagree about who changed `billing-route`. timestamps and actor fields don't line up. anyone touch export shape recently?

maria: i rolled a small change to the serializer last week to drop actor_email by default (PII reduction). i thought we only affected streaming endpoints. didn't touch exports AFAIK.

tj: we never agreed to drop email for compliance exports. docs mention `actor.email` is optional, but customers relying on \"who did what\" expect a full identity for audit exports.

lexi: if the UI CSV shows pseudonymized actors but NDJSON has real emails or vice versa that's a bug. can you paste a tiny sample payload (redact as needed) and tenant id? also: any deploys/rollouts around the time?

ashok: tenant `acme-inc`. sample snippets: 

NDJSON line:
```
{"event":"policy.update","policy":"billing-route","actor":{"actor_id":"user:123","actor_email":"maria@acme.com"},"ts":"2026-03-18T14:02:11Z","rollout_id":"rt-42"}
```

Console CSV row exported same time: `2026-03-18 14:02:11, billing-route, user:pseud-7f3, <redacted>, rt-42`

So NDJSON has full email, CSV has pseudonymized actor id (weird mix).

deploy-bot: deploy `export-service@v2.14.0` -> staging succeeded at 2026-03-18T13:58:02Z :white_check_mark:

maria: ugh — i accidentally flipped `pseudonymize.actor=true` into the shared serializer config. that flag was supposed to be only for streaming/console preview, not for full export. i'll revert the flag ASAP.

tj: before you revert we need to consider existing exports — we can't silently mutate historical files. proposal:
- revert flag so new exports have full actor fields by default for compliance tenants
- add a manifest/header to each export bundle that records `pii_mode: pseudonymized|full` and `exported_by` + `export_version`
- console should surface a badge in the download modal: \"Actors pseudonymized\" when applicable

lexi: +1. also add telemetry event `export.generated` with properties `{tenant, pii_mode, rows, bytes, job_id}` so support can triage. put `pii_mode` in top-level manifest JSON.

ashok: we also need attribution linkage: exports should include `original_request_id` and `rollout_id` so consumers can map events back to console actions and rollouts. otherwise downstream EDR/siem can't match.

maria: i'll open a PR that does three things: revert the bad config change, patch the export writer to include a manifest.json with `pii_mode` and `export_version`, and add a console badge + text explaining what pseudonymized means. PR in ~30m.

lexi: add a short changelog entry and update the docs page (/docs/audit-exports) so legal/compliance know what changed. also include migration notes: \"files generated with pii_mode=pseudonymized should not be reprocessed to replace actor ids\".

ashok: creating ops ticket to add backpressure/quota guard: large exports sometimes saturate the export workers and we saw retry storms. ticket #EXPORT-512: \"throttle export worker concurrency + surface estimated runtime in modal\".

maria: test plan in PR: unit tests for ndjson->csv mapping, e2e smoke that downloads and validates `actor` fields for a compliance tenant, and a lint to ensure exporters always emit `manifest.json`.

tj: please also add an integration test that asserts `export.generated` telemetry is emitted and contains `pii_mode`. means we can alert if mismatches recur.

lexi: sounds good. once PR is up ping me and i'll review the UX bits. after deploy we should send a short note to customer ops with the explanation + how to tell whether a past export is pseudonymized (manifest + job_id).

ashok: thanks — i'll attach the ops ticket and add the customer incident link.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/export-service/pull/1487 (draft) — includes revert + manifest + badge markup. will switch to ready-for-review after tests run.

lexi: :thumbsup: nice. follow-up: could we add a small `export-health` dashboard (per-tenant export latency, rows/sec, failure-rate) so we can catch any future regressions faster?

ashok: filing DASH-EXPORT-23 for that.

deploy-bot: deploy `export-service@v2.14.1` -> canary started 2026-03-18T15:42:10Z

maria: thanks everyone — will keep thread updated with PR status and test results.

tj: once deployed let's run a compliance tenant smoke end-to-end and notify support.

lexi: SGTM.
